items.title: Tax-Themed Google Ads Lead to BYOVD EDR Killer in Huntress-Traced Malvertising Campaign
items.description: Every April, millions of Americans rush to file taxes before the deadline — and attackers count on it. A large-scale malvertising campaign, active since at least January 2026, has been exploiting that urgency by placing fake tax form pages through Google Ads, ultimately deploying a kernel-mode EDR killer on victim machines.
